subtasks.description: Declare 4-bit register rcnt, 32-bit register out_reg, and a constant array RC_TABLE[0:9] holding 8-bit round constants 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x1B, 0x36.
constraints: Port declarations must exactly match S003: clk (input), kld (input), out (output reg [31:0]).

subtasks.description: Combinational logic to compute next_rc_byte: if kld=1, output 0x01; if rcnt>9, output 0x00; else output RC_TABLE[rcnt].
Sequential always block on posedge clk: if kld, rcnt <= 0; else rcnt <= rcnt+1; out_reg <= {next_rc_byte, 24'h000000}.
